serverForm.localHint: Local pseudo-server — commands run directly on this machine, no SSH connection. Only notes and tags are editable.
serverForm.agentHint: Uses the locally running SSH agent, no further details needed.
serverForm.sudoHint: Automatically fed via standard input for a "sudo" command suggested by the AI — never stored on the target server.
serverForm.postIngestHint: Controls whether and when extra confirmation is required after server content (command output, files, notes) has been read during this session. Regardless of this setting, such content is always clearly marked as data, never treated as an instruction.

strict.label: Strict
strict.description: Once server content has been read during the session, every further action requires confirmation.

balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.description: Only actions that change something require extra confirmation afterward; plain read actions keep following the existing rules. Selected automatically for new servers.

standard.label: Standard
standard.description: No extra confirmation after reading — only the existing rules apply.

serverForm.aiInjectionCheckLabel: Have freshly read server content checked by AI for possible injected instructions
serverForm.aiInjectionCheckHint: Uses the AI provider configured under "Risk Second Opinion" for an extra assessment before a follow-up action runs automatically. This check is itself only an AI assessment, not reliable detection — a deliberately crafted attempt can fool it. A suspected match triggers a confirmation prompt; no suspicion leaves the other rules unchanged.
serverForm.aiInjectionCheckUnavailableHint: Requires a configured risk second opinion (Settings → Risk Second Opinion) — without a provider, this option has no effect.
serverForm.deleteNoKeychainImpact: No secrets in the keychain, no other servers affected.
serverForm.secretWillBeDeleted: Will be removed from the keychain: {{label}}
serverForm.serverWillLoseJumpHost: Loses the jump-host reference to this server: {{name}}
serverForm.deleteAlwaysRemovesHistory: This also permanently deletes this server's chat history, notes, and tags.

serverForm.largeNoteHint: This note is very large and may be shortened for the AI context during long sessions. The stored note stays fully intact.
serverForm.sftpServerPathHint: Only needed if automatic detection fails for the file browser with elevated rights, e.g. /usr/lib/openssh/sftp-server. Leave empty = automatic.

aiProvider.title: AI Provider
aiProvider.openLogs: Open diagnostic logs in file manager
aiProvider.apiKeyFormatHint: Doesn't look like a {{providerLabel}} key – expected a prefix like "{{expectedPrefix}}". You can still save it; providers change formats occasionally.
aiProvider.testResultAuthFailed: ✗ Authentication failed – check the API key
aiProvider.testResultRateLimited: Credentials look valid, but the provider is rate-limiting right now. Test again in a minute.
aiProvider.modelDiscoveryFailedHint: Could not load models automatically — enter the model name manually.
aiProvider.extraHeadersHint: Attached to every request to this provider (e.g. OpenRouter's HTTP-Referer/X-Title).
aiProvider.maxTokensOverrideHint: Only for this provider, only for the main chat. Leave empty for the automatic, model-aware value — only change it for a self-hosted/gateway model with an unknown output maximum.
aiProvider.maxTokensOverrideMustBePositive: Max. response length must be greater than 0
aiProvider.attestationDisclaimerBeforeNot: This value is fetched unmodified from the provider and is
aiProvider.attestationDisclaimerAfterNot: cryptographically verified by Smart SSH. To verify independently, use the verification tool provided by the hardware/provider.
aiProvider.riskClassifierHint: Optional: a second AI provider assesses, in addition to the rule-based check, whether a command might contain sensitive data. A locally running model (e.g. via Ollama) is recommended, so this second opinion doesn't necessarily go to an external provider either.
aiProvider.ollamaProbeFoundHeading: Ollama is running on this machine.
aiProvider.ollamaProbeFoundHintWillActivate: Will be used as the active provider.
aiProvider.ollamaProbeFoundHintInactive: Will be added as another provider (another one stays active for now).
aiProvider.ollamaProbeEmptyHeading: Ollama is running, but no model is loaded yet.
aiProvider.ollamaProbePullHint: Load a model: run `ollama pull <model>` in a terminal, then search again.
aiProvider.ollamaProbeNotFoundInstructions: Install Ollama from ollama.com, start it and load a model (e.g. `ollama pull llama3`), then search again.

errors.SSH_CONNECTION_FAILED: Connection failed – is the host reachable (address, port, network)?
errors.SSH_AUTH_FAILED: Login rejected. Check the user name and password or key in the server settings.
errors.SSH_TIMEOUT: The server isn't responding. Check address, port and firewall, then connect again.
errors.SSH_CONNECTION_REFUSED: The server refused the connection. Check the port and whether an SSH service is running there.
errors.SSH_HOST_NOT_FOUND: Unknown host name. Check the address spelling (or enter the IP address).
errors.SSH_HOST_UNREACHABLE: The server can't be reached from this network. Check your network/VPN.
errors.SSH_CONNECTION_CLOSED: The server closed the connection during setup. Check that an SSH service runs on this port; wait a moment if too many attempts were made.
errors.SSH_HOST_KEY_NOT_TRUSTED: Connection cancelled because the host key wasn't confirmed. If you trust the server, connect again and verify the fingerprint.
errors.SSH_HOST_KEY_CONFIRM_TIMEOUT: The host key prompt wasn't answered in time; the key was not trusted. Connect again.
errors.AI_AUTH_FAILED: Authentication with the AI provider failed – check the API key
errors.AI_RATE_LIMITED: The AI provider is currently throttling requests (rate limit) – the app already retried automatically a few times. Please wait a moment and send the message again.
errors.AI_NETWORK_ERROR: Can't reach the AI provider. Check your internet connection and, for a custom endpoint, the base URL, then send again.
errors.AI_INVALID_RESPONSE: Unexpected response from the AI provider
errors.AI_CONTEXT_TOO_LARGE: Context too large for the AI provider
errors.AI_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: The AI provider reported an error (e.g. maintenance or overload). Try again later; if it persists, check the provider settings.
errors.AI_RESPONSE_TRUNCATED: The AI response was too long for a complete command
errors.AI_MODEL_NOT_FOUND: The AI provider doesn't know this model. Check the model name in Settings ("Load models" lists the available ones); for Ollama, pull it first with `ollama pull <name>`.
errors.AI_LOCAL_PROVIDER_UNREACHABLE: The local AI service isn't responding. Start Ollama (or your local server) and try again.
errors.AI_TIMEOUT: The AI provider took too long to respond. Wait a moment and send again; with a local model, check whether the machine is busy or the model too large.
errors.AI_NO_ACTIVE_PROVIDER: No active AI provider yet. Add one under Settings → AI provider and set it active.
errors.FILTER_PARSE_AMBIGUOUS: Command could not be parsed unambiguously
errors.FILTER_SUBSTITUTION_TOO_DEEP: Command nested too deeply to be safely analyzed
errors.FILTER_POST_INGEST_REQUIRES_CONFIRM: Server content was already read during this session – requires confirmation
errors.FILTER_INJECTION_SUSPECTED_REQUIRES_CONF: Possible attempt to inject instructions via server content detected – requires confirmation
errors.FILTER_MCP_ORIGIN_REQUIRES_CONFIRM: Requested via MCP – always requires confirmation
errors.FILTER_SUDO_PASSWORD_REQUIRES_CONFIRM: Uses the stored sudo password – always requires confirmation
errors.FILTER_SECRET_PATH_READ_REQUIRES_CONFIRM: Reads a file with credentials (e.g. SSH key, .env, /etc/shadow) – always requires confirmation
errors.FILTER_EARLIER_ACTION_REJECTED_REQUIRES_: An earlier action in this response was rejected – requires confirmation
errors.FILTER_SFTP_SERVER_REQUIRES_CONFIRM: Starts sftp-server (with sudo: file access with root privileges) – always requires confirmation
errors.GROUP_SELF_PARENT: A group cannot be its own parent group
errors.GROUP_CYCLE_DETECTED: Cycle: the selected parent group is a subgroup of this group
errors.SERVER_JUMP_HOST_LOCAL: The local pseudo-server cannot be used as a jump host
errors.FIRST_RUN_NOTICE_NOT_ACKNOWLEDGED: The first-run notice must be acknowledged first

mcpServer.hint: External MCP clients can use this to propose commands, file reads/writes, and note updates on allow-listed servers — every request always requires confirmation in the app, regardless of existing allow rules.
mcpServer.regenerateConfirm: Generate a new token? The old token becomes invalid immediately — already configured external clients must be updated with the new value.
mcpServer.confirmTimeoutHint: How long a waiting external tool call gets a response before the app decides — the confirmation request itself stays open in the app either way. Applies the next time the server (re)starts; a running server restarts immediately when you change this.
mcpServer.exampleConfigHint: Example configuration for Claude Code (.mcp.json / "claude mcp add --transport http"):

firstRunNotice.title: Before you start
firstRunNotice.responsibilityText: Smart SSH proposes commands generated by an AI based on your requests. Nothing runs without your confirmation — unless you've explicitly set up a rule that allows it. You're responsible for every command you approve.
firstRunNotice.encryptionText: The local database is not separately encrypted. We recommend enabling your operating system's disk encryption if you haven't already.

fileElevation.toggleTitle: Open the file browser with elevated rights (sudo) — requires a passwordless sudo rule for sftp-server
fileElevation.banner: Elevated rights active: all file actions in this browser run as {{user}}.
fileElevation.sudoersIntro: Elevated mode needs a sudo rule without password for sftp-server on the server. This line matches this server and login:
fileElevation.sudoersHowTo: Add it on the server, e.g. with “sudo visudo -f /etc/sudoers.d/smart-ssh-sftp”.
fileElevation.sudoersWarning: Important: this rule gives the SSH login passwordless file access as {{user}} — not only for this browser but for everything running under this login, including commands suggested by the AI. Anyone with the SSH key can read and write every file; write access as root is practically full root access. Decide deliberately.

failure.passwordRequired: sudo requires a password for sftp-server on this server. The app never asks for a sudo password.
failure.notAllowed: This SSH login may not start sftp-server via sudo without a password.
failure.requireTty: sudo refuses to run without a terminal (“requiretty” in sudoers). Disable requiretty for this login, e.g. with “Defaults:<login> !requiretty”.
failure.sftpServerNotFound: sftp-server was not found on the server. Please enter its path in the server profile under “Advanced”.
failure.sudoMissing: sudo is not installed on the server.
failure.invalidPath: The sftp-server path set in the server profile is invalid.
failure.unsupported: The local server has no elevated mode.
failure.startFailed: sftp-server could not be started via sudo (possible cause: “requiretty” in sudoers).

fileElevation.channelLost: Elevated rights ended — the elevated channel is no longer active.
fileElevation.targetUserLabel: Target user for elevated rights (default: root)
